messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Users cannot locate, update, or adjust claim reserves after approval without triggering unwanted alerts. This delays accurate financial tracking and forces reliance on manual workarounds.",
 "similar": [
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4128",
   "similarity": 0.075,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now allows users to filter claims by date range, status, and claim type, making it easier to locate specific claims without scrolling through unrelated entries.\", \"id\": 4128, \"name\": \"Claim search refinements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4127",
   "similarity": 0.061,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-10-06T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Users can now upload multiple documents at once to a claim in Keelwater, streamlining the process and reducing manual effort for claims handlers.\", \"id\": 4127, \"name\": \"Bulk upload documents to a claim\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4135",
   "similarity": 0.054,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater's claim information display provides a clear, real-time overview of active claims, including status, assigned adjuster, and key dates, helping users stay informed without switching screens.\", \"id\": 4135, \"name\": \"Claim information display\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 2}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4133",
   "similarity": 0.053,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater's document classifier confidence threshold setting allows users to define the minimum confidence level required for automatic categorization of claims documents, ensuring only high-certainty classifications are applied without manual review.\", \"id\": 4133, \"name\": \"Document classifier confidence threshold\", \"started\": false, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 1}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4137",
   "similarity": 0.052,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Users can navigate through claim reports using intuitive shortcuts, streamlining access to key data without leaving the current view. Keelwater’s interface ensures quick filtering and drill-downs for efficient claim analysis.\", \"id\": 4137, \"name\": \"Reporting navigation\", \"started\": false, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 1}"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem concerns locating, updating, or adjusting claim reserves after approval without triggering unwanted alerts. The five similar stories—claim search refinements (4128, completed), bulk document upload (4127, completed), claim information display (4135), document classifier threshold (4133), and reporting navigation (4137)—all concern search, documents, display, and reporting, not reserve adjustments or alert behavior. None of the completed stories or unstarted/in-progress items addresses the same problem, and no roadmap coverage was found.", "verdict": "pass"}
